subject: Proposal: StudioVerse x Redwood — 'Ecosystem Showcase' Demo Night
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@studioverse.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Quick idea — partner demo night w/ StudioVerse + Redwood

Hi Rishi + Marissa,

Hope you both are well — Elena at StudioVerse here. We run a monthly ‘Studio Showcase’ series (small-format, invitation-only demo nights for product teams and integrators) and would love to co-host the December edition with Redwood. High level: 90-minute evening session, 3 short live demos (15 min each), a moderated Q&A, and a short product spotlight from each partner.

Why we think it’s a fit:
- Audience: 60–100 engineers and product leads who care about deployment & inference economics.
- Format: live demos + a breakout office-hours table with partner reps.
- Marketing: shared co-branded invites, targeted run to our partner lists and Redwood's developer newsletter.

Ask: are you interested? If yes, we can slot it the week of Dec 13 (evening PST) and share a one-pager + a draft sponsorship agreement. We’d request one Redwood engineer (plus a PM) for the demos and a short sponsor budget to cover promotion / a small travel stipend for a studio guest.

Attaching a one-pager for context. Happy to hop on a 30-min planning call this week.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Partnerships, StudioVerse
elena.park@studioverse.ai
(attachment: StudioVerse_DemoNight_OnePager.pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@studioverse.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 18:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick idea — partner demo night w/ StudioVerse + Redwood

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the one-pager, looks promising. We’re interested. A few quick items before we lock a date:

1) Audience fit — can you share a recent attendee profile (roles, approximate company size distribution)?
2) Promotion — what channels do you commit to (email list size, social amplification)?
3) Ops — will there be an event recording & on-demand asset we can host on our site?

We can do a 30-min planning call Wednesday 12/2 10am PT or Thursday 12/3 9am PT — Marissa/Ben, does either slot work for you?

We should also confirm a basic commercial framework (sponsorship fee + co-marketing spend) so Marissa can route approval.

Thanks — looking forward,
Rishi
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena.park@studioverse.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 02:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick idea — partner demo night w/ StudioVerse + Redwood

Thanks — quick commercial/ops notes from my side:

- Sponsor ask: historically partners pay a modest sponsorship ($3k–6k) to cover promotion, platform fees, and recording edits. If StudioVerse prefers a trade, we can discuss ad credits + content swap instead.
- Headcount: we can commit 2 Redwood reps for the evening (one engineer for a 15-min demo + one product marketing for the spotlight).
- Promotion cadence: we need at least 3 weeks lead time for our developer newsletter; for a Dec event we’ll need final copy by 12/6.
- Measurement: we'll expect a post-event leads export (emails + company) and a short wrap deck.

If StudioVerse can share attendee profile and the promo channels Rishi asked for, I’ll draft a short commercial memo and route approval.

Marissa Cole
Director, Partnerships & GTM, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(attachment: none)

From: Elena Park <elena.park@studioverse.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jake Morales <jake.morales@studioverse.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 07:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick idea — partner demo night w/ StudioVerse + Redwood

Appreciate the quick turnaround — answers below and attaching a short sponsorship agreement for ease:

- Attendee profile: ~55% engineers (SDE/Staff/Engineering leads), 30% product/PM, 15% DevOps/Platform. Typical company size mix: 40% mid-market (50–500), 30% startups, 30% enterprise evaluation.
- Promo channels: weekly partner newsletter (12k subscribers), partner socials (LinkedIn/X) with paid amplification for one week, targeted invite list for engineering leads (approx. 2k names). We’ll also host the recording on StudioVerse’s on-demand hub and provide an embedable recording link.
- Recording: yes — we record, we’ll provide a trimmed 10–12 minute highlight clip and the full recording within 5 business days.

Attachment: StudioVerse_DemoNight_OnePager.pdf (overview + sample attendee list). Also, here’s a DocuSign link for the standard sponsor agreement: https://www.docusign.com/Envelope/UV-12345-StudVxRDW

If the commercial range Marissa suggested is fine, we can sign and lock the date Dec 15, 2026 (evening PT). Proposed agenda: 6:00pm intro & sponsor spot (Redwood product highlight), 6:10–6:55 three 15-minute demos, 7:00–7:30 moderated Q&A + breakout rooms.

Let me know if we should add a co-branded social campaign draft; Jake can share creative next.

Best,
Elena Park
Head of Partnerships, StudioVerse
(attachment: StudioVerse_DemoNight_OnePager.pdf)

Elena/Jake — please go ahead and send the DocuSign link to me directly (cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai). Once signed, we’ll get copy to you by EOD 12/6 and lock speakers (we’ll bring an engineer from the runtime team and Sam from Product Marketing).
